description:
FILED s522a (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-19) from the #3061 acceptance runs: Text-CSV-2.04's t/util.pl transpiles now, and 15 t/ files run rows they never ran.  Every row below was checked against TWO emulations under real perl 5.40.3 (scratch/s522a/fu/run.sh: utf8::is_utf8 forced to 1 = #1389; fu/run2.sh: that PLUS Text::CSV_PP's `%{$self->{_CACHE}} = %$ctx` stores removed = #3611) and is NOT reproduced by either -- so it is a different mechanism.  Outputs: scratch/s522a/csv/<file>.out in the s522a worktree.

LOUD (pre-existing).  `print utf8::valid("abc") ? 1 : 0` -> perl 1, PCL dies "Undefined subroutine &UTF8::valid called" (probe scratch/s522a/pr/uv.pl).  PCL strings are always well-formed character strings, so `utf8::valid` answers 1 for every defined string (perl: false only for a malformed internal UTF-8 buffer, which PCL cannot hold).  Belongs beside utf8::is_utf8 / decode in the runtime (the utf8:: core subs, DECIDED: `defined &utf8::...` is TRUE).  Text-CSV t/50_utf8.t stops at row 65 and t/70_rt.t at row 443 (19,997 rows behind it) with this die; their *PLAN* rows are blessed with this cause.  Related: #3322 (its boolean answer).


=== DONE (s523d, Opus 5.5, 2026-10-20/22, commit 86d47ade on the rebased branch; was 4498dc9a) ===
`utf8::valid` = `utf8::pl-valid` in cl/pcl-runtime.lisp beside pl-is_utf8, a CORE sub (in the :defined dolist) answering 1 for every value: a PCL string is a CL character string and cannot hold a malformed buffer (perl 5.40.3 probe scratch/s523d/pr/uv.pl: 1 for string, "", wide, latin-1, 5, 1.5, undef, [], sub).  Guard Pl/t/is-utf8-01.t r7 (inverse: base dies "Undefined subroutine &UTF8::valid called").  Text-CSV 50_utf8.t runs 93 of 93: 89/4 -- r64 #3616 (blessed), r71 `String 0-1` NEWLY REACHED = `use bytes` (a regex under `use bytes` must see the UTF-8 octets; CSV_PP's quote_binary test /[\x00-\x1f\x7f-\xa0]/ matches 0x82 of U+20AC in perl -- probe pr/ub.pl: perl m, PCL no; NS:use bytes), r85 + r93 `not utf8` NEWLY REACHED = #1389.  70_rt.t runs 470 of 20,469: the 20,000-row BIG_LOOP stops at its first mismatch, row 450 `Data 1/0 (11)` = the same `use bytes` quote_binary mechanism (`1,Екинбург№` vs `1,"Екинбург№"`); r464 `Length` 8 vs 7 = #1389 probable (CSV_PP 2206 `$ctx->{utf8} = utf8::is_utf8($src)`).  Board rows edited with these causes (s523d).
subject: utf8::valid is not implemented: "Undefined subroutine &UTF8::valid called" -- stops Text-CSV 50_utf8.t (at 65 of 93) and 70_rt.t (at 443 of 20469)
